root_idea.summary: The root centers on distance between the extremities of something, breadth, and reaching its furthest limit.
root_idea.development: This orientation yields the meanings of sides, regions, and the horizon; movement through distant regions; and, figuratively, attaining the utmost degree or surpassing others. Other lexical developments, including leather terminology, are separately attested Classical uses.

qac_form_accounting.reason: The Quranic noun is presented under the normalized citation form أُفُق.

senses.definition: A side, region, or extremity; especially the horizon or far boundary of the sky or earth.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, the plural آفاق denotes regions or horizons in 41:53, while the singular أُفُق denotes the horizon in 53:7 and 81:23. These are number and contextual differences within the same lexical sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go one’s own way, wander heedlessly, or go away through the regions of the land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I verb; the construction may describe going into or through the country.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To attain the utmost degree in generosity, knowledge, eloquence, chasteness of speech, or other excellent qualities; one who reaches this degree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verbal and adjectival uses describe reaching an extreme of excellence rather than merely traveling to a region.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To overcome, surpass, or excel another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: With عَلَيْهِ, it means to outdo or precede another in excellence.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be beautiful, admirable, excellent, or of exceptional breeding and quality.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied especially to horses, mares, camels, and she-camels; the adjectival use may refer to generous or high-bred stock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To give some people more than others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the construction أَفَقَ فِي العَطَاءِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To write or issue documents granting gifts and seal them.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An alternative interpretation of the poetic expression concerning giving gifts.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tan a hide until it becomes an أَفِيق.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive leather-working use with a hide as its object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To come from a region and arrive at someone’s abode as a guest.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested with بِنا in the sense of coming to us and alighting with us.
Attested with بِهِ in a separately reported construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The main or middle course of a road, its face, or its surface.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of the central or plainly exposed part of a road; its plural is آفاق.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The flank or flanks; also the skin, including a skin considered as a receptacle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer to the body’s side or to a skin that can be filled.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The side or lateral part of a tent.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In tent terminology, it may denote the part between the anterior structural pieces or the lateral sections of a desert tent.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The burying of a skin or hide in earth so that its hair can be removed and it can be prepared for tanning.
A person from the outlying regions, or one who travels through the regions, especially in search of sustenance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In pilgrimage terminology, it refers to one outside the places where pilgrims entering Mecca assume ihram.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A bucket that excels other buckets.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of an unusually superior bucket.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A skin or hide that is untanned or incompletely tanned, including hide at an intermediate stage of preparation; also a water-skin made from such hide.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Authorities differ over the exact tanning stage denoted; the term can also be extended to a skin or hide generally, including that of a person or animal.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Going away or through the regions.
Attaining the utmost degree of excellence.
Beauty or excellence in a horse or camel.
Differential giving, an alternative gift-document interpretation, and going into the regions.
Tanning a hide into an أفيق.
Coming from a region or reaching someone.
Main or surface part of a road.
Disputed plural analysis, without a new lexical meaning.
Regional or traveling person, including the pilgrimage usage.
Untanned or incompletely tanned hide and related skin uses.
Adjectival excellence and high-bred animal usage.

cautions: Classical sources differ over the precise tanning stage designated by أَفِيقٌ; the entry preserves the shared hide-related meaning without forcing one technical stage.
The Quranic form group contains both the singular citation form and inflected plural/singular occurrences; all three occurrences are presented under أُفُق.
